candidates.desc: Every leg whose nflverse closing spread is +1.5/+2/+2.5 (dog) or -7.5/-8/-8.5 (fav), all game types; pair legs within a week in kickoff order.
R1 restricted to closing total_line <= 48.5 (the published 'total < 49' filter).

Executable version of R2: Wong range judged on the BEST allowed-book number at the last pre-kick snapshot (~1h before kickoff; my_books.json books), teased from that number; closing total <= 48.5. Evaluated only where snapshot data exists (2023-2025).
